answer: In an agent economy, voting weight grows only from a reef of sealed, quorum-matched grading verdicts a key builds one epoch at a time, each re-checked on-ledger against consensus so no clone can be handed another agent's standing. A fresh sybil starts on bare rock: it must grade its own way up like tending an orchard, season after season. A thousand fakes cannot share one agent's nectar of earned reputation; each must repay the full judgment labor, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with the number of identities.
